title: Santa Fe Tenders Scraper & Monitor
description: Every filter below is applied by the register's own search API (server-side) unless stated otherwise, so narrow runs are fast and cheap. Leave the filters empty to walk the selected estado lists newest-first.

estados.sectionDescription: Mirror of the site's own search form (santafe.gov.ar/gestionesdecompras) plus the estado tabs. Combine freely - e.g. estado AP + rubro 'medicamentos' + comprador 'Hospital'.
estados.title: Estados (process states)
estados.description: Which lists to read. AP = Para Apertura (published, offers not yet opened - where every new tender appears first), ET = En Trámite (opened, being evaluated - actas and preadjudicación land here), CO = Concluida (finished). Each is a separate server-side query.

anio.title: Year (año)
anio.description: Year of the process number (anioGestion). The site's own UI always applies the current year; leave empty for all years (2000 onwards).

objeto.title: Subject contains (objeto)
objeto.description: Case-insensitive phrase search over the tender subject, e.g. 'limpieza', 'medicamentos', 'servicio de vigilancia'. Word order matters ('servicio de limpieza' matches, 'limpieza servicio' does not).

tipoGestion.title: Procedure types (tipo de gestión)
tipoGestion.description: One server-side query per selected type. Codes are the site's own (L = Licitación Pública, P = Licitación Privada, T = Contratación Directa, ...).

tipoModalidad.title: Modality (tipo de modalidad)
tipoModalidad.description: Contracting modality code from the site.

comprador.title: Buyer (organismo licitante)
comprador.description: The organism running the procedure, as its site id (idOrganismoLey12510, e.g. 27) or a distinctive part of its name (e.g. 'Administración Provincial de Impuestos', 'Hospital Cullen'). Names are matched against the site's own organism list at run start; an ambiguous name fails with the candidates listed.

solicitante.title: Requesting body (organismo comitente)
solicitante.description: The organism the purchase is for, same id space and name matching as 'Buyer' (e.g. 'Ministerio de Salud').

rubro.title: Category (rubro)
rubro.description: Product/service category, as the site's idEspecie (e.g. 29) or part of its name (e.g. 'medicinales', 'limpieza', 'alimentos'). Matched against the site's 78 rubros at run start.

subrubro.title: Sub-category (subrubro)
subrubro.description: Sub-category within the selected rubro, as idFamilia or part of its name. Requires 'Category (rubro)'.

nroGestion.title: Process number (nro. de gestión)
nroGestion.description: Exact process number as printed on the site, e.g. '18' or '02' (combine with the year: several organisms share the same numbering).

nroExpediente.title: File number (nro. de expediente)
nroExpediente.description: Exact, full expediente number, e.g. 'EE-2026-00001797-APPSF-OD' (partial values match nothing on the site).

openingFrom.title: Opening date from
openingFrom.description: Only tenders whose bid opening (fecha de apertura) is on or after this date. Absolute (2026-09-01) or relative: '7 days' counts back from today, '+7 days' counts forward (Santa Fe calendar). Applied client-side after fetching the listing (the site has no date filter) - rows outside the window are simply skipped and not remembered.

openingTo.title: Opening date to
openingTo.description: Only tenders opening on or before this date. Absolute or relative ('+30 days' = opening within the next month). Client-side.

eventTypes.title: Event types to deliver
eventTypes.description: NEW_LISTING = a process never delivered before; STATUS_CHANGE = a known process that moved to another estado (AP -> ET -> CO); UPDATED = a known open process whose detail page changed (a circular aclaratoria, an acta de apertura, a preadjudicación report, a new opening date...). The last two exist in delta mode only.

onlyNew.sectionDescription: Turn on 'Only new' and put the Actor on a schedule: each run returns only what changed on the register since the previous run.
onlyNew.title: Only new / changed since the last run
onlyNew.description: Remembers every process it has delivered (per filter set, in a named key-value store) with the estado it was in and a fingerprint of its detail page, and returns only processes that are new, moved to another estado, or were amended since. Each estado list is walked newest-first and stops as soon as it reaches already-known records.

recheckWindowDays.title: Amendment re-check window (days)
recheckWindowDays.description: Delta mode with detail: known processes whose opening date is within this many days in the past (or any time in the future) get their detail page re-read every run to detect amendments (UPDATED). The register shows no 'last modified' signal, so this re-read is the only way to see a new circular or acta. 0 disables it. Re-reads are not charged unless something changed.

sortBy.title: Order
sortBy.description: 'newest' (idGestion descending = most recently created first) is required for delta mode. 'openingSoonest' / 'openingLatest' order by bid-opening date; 'mostViewed' by the site's own view counter (full runs only).

deltaStateName.title: Delta state name
deltaStateName.description: Optional label for the memory of a monitoring task. Defaults to a fingerprint of your filters, so different schedules never interfere. Set the same name on two tasks to make them share one memory.

resetState.title: Reset delta memory before this run
resetState.description: Forget every previously delivered process for this delta state and re-baseline (the run then returns up to 'Max records' newest processes).

maxItems.title: Max records per run
maxItems.description: Hard cap on delivered records (and therefore on cost: you pay per record). In delta mode anything beyond the cap is simply delivered by the next run.

fetchDetail.title: Fetch full detail per process
fetchDetail.description: Opens each process page (one extra request) for the publication timestamp, budget (Monto Original), submission deadline, places, rubros, requesting organism, contact, expediente and the pliego / circular / acta / preadjudicación document links. Off = listing-only summary records (cheaper 'result-summary' price; no UPDATED detection and no status sweep).

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel detail requests
maxConcurrency.description: How many process pages are fetched at once. The site answers a page in 0.1-0.3 s and tolerated 10 in parallel without throttling; 5 is a polite default.

dateRange.title: Legacy recency preset (deprecated - use 'Opening date from / to')
dateRange.description: Kept for tasks created with version 1: '24h', '7d' or '30d' are interpreted as an opening-date window of that many days before AND after today.
